body_html:
The Global Twilight armchair pairs a sculpted, flared wood veneer back with an upholstered Ultracell foam seat, giving reception areas and waiting rooms a confident, contemporary anchor. Fixed arms and a clean silhouette make it equally at home in meeting rooms, training spaces and multi-purpose rooms. Built in Canada by Global Furniture Group and tested to exceed ANSI/BIFMA standards, it is made to hold up to daily institutional use.

Features

  • Flared wood veneer back with a refined, contemporary profile
  • Upholstered seat over high-density Ultracell foam for all-day comfort
  • Fixed arms for added support and easy entry and exit
  • Compatible with Comet tables and connecting brackets for ganged training and multi-purpose layouts
  • Optional casters for fast reconfiguration; felt or rubber glides available
  • Wide range of wood veneer back finishes and three frame finishes (Black, Tungsten, Absolute)

Specifications

Model 2198WS is the wood-veneer-back armchair in the Twilight series. The armless companion model (2199C) measures 20"W x 22"D x 35"H; with fixed arms the 2198WS is wider. It carries a limited lifetime warranty on the frame and components, with 5 years on upholstery, foam and mesh.

A verified OECM-eligible supplier, Brant Business Interiors helps Ontario school boards, hospitals and municipalities purchase without an open tender.
